## 4. Release packets

Release packet fees may be invoiced only after the packet is complete and sponsor QA accepts the sterilization documentation. Draft, incomplete, or rejected packets are not billable as final release packets.

## 6. Required evidence

Quality-related invoice lines must reference batch ID, release status, release date, quality agreement section, test record, deviation record, or sponsor approval as applicable.

contract_policy_sections.text:
## 3. Engineering batch classification

Engineering batch work is billed at the engineering batch rate and may not be invoiced as a GMP validation batch unless the approved protocol identifies the batch as GMP validation and sponsor QA accepts the executed batch record.

## 5. Payment leakage categories

Common leakage categories include duplicate billing, off-contract fees, wrong rate, wrong volume, missed discount, invalid true-up, early milestone billing, unreleased batch billing, and unsupported pass-through charges.

required_gaps: The approved protocol classification and sponsor QA acceptance of the executed batch record are unverified.
